settings.heading:
Your content.
Your code.
Your corner of the web.
settings.label: LOCAL-FIRST. OPEN SOURCE.
settings.subheading: A static site generator with a visual editor built in. Write, design, and publish from a folder of files you own.

settings.label: BUILT FOR THE WAY YOU WORK
settings.heading: A simpler stack. A complete workflow.

settings.title: Files, not a database
settings.body: Content is markdown with frontmatter, layout is JSON, design is Liqx templates. Everything lives in your repository and reads fine in any editor.

settings.title: A real CMS
settings.body: Collections, a field builder with 29 field types, relationships, media with alt text and resizing, navigation menus — writing the same files you would.

settings.title: A visual editor
settings.body: Pages are sections and blocks with settings declared in their templates. Click, edit, and watch the live preview update.

settings.title: Git is the history
settings.body: Save to your working tree. Review the diff. Commit when you are ready, and use Git to keep your history.

settings.title: Fast, incremental builds
settings.body: Each page records what it read; only what changed is rebuilt. Images are resized once and cached.

settings.title: Themes, addons, plugins
settings.body: Layer a theme under your site, add addons on top, and extend the build, the head and the dashboard with plugins.
